title: Design System: Fuel Monitoring Management System

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action button for submitting forms, logging utilization, and approving orders.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #0d6efd; color: #f8f9fa; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #0b5ed7; }

components.description: Secondary actions like canceling or resetting form inputs.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background-color: #49454F; color: #f8f9fa; border: none; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Figtree', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #CAC4D0; color: #1c1b1f; }

narrative.overview: The Fuel Monitoring Management System's visual identity is inspired by highly functional, high-contrast physical hardware terminals and industrial dashboards. It features a dark-by-default environment optimized to minimize eye strain during long-shift operational use.
keyCharacteristics: Task-Focused Clarity: Layouts prioritize tables, rapid input form controls, and prominent status badges.
High-Contrast Dark Aesthetic: Built on top of Bootstrap 5.3's dark theme using deeply dark, high-contrast surface elements.
Micro-tactile feedback: Clickable UI elements utilize standard transitions to feel modern, responsive, and tactile.

rules.name: The Strict Dark Theme Rule
rules.body: The interface is built exclusively around the Bootstrap 5.3 dark theme (data-bs-theme="dark"). Light backgrounds are forbidden except in print views.

rules.name: The Interactive Highlight Rule
rules.body: Accent colors (Command Blue) must occupy less than 15% of any screen surface.

rules.name: The Condensed Heading Rule
rules.body: All headings (h1 through h6) must carry a condensed letter spacing (-0.02em).

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: Drop shadows are only permitted for floating components that exist outside the flat flow (modals, tooltips).

dos: Do ensure all clickable anchor tags, select boxes, buttons, and custom button roles have cursor: pointer on hover.
Do clear the Laravel configuration cache (php artisan config:clear) before running automated tests.
Do use native Bootstrap spacing classes to preserve the 8px grid alignment.
donts: Don't use arbitrary inline hex color values for texts or backgrounds.
Don't add complex drop shadows to standard widgets or dashboard cards.
Don't disable smooth transition animations on interactive states.
